name: M42, Poznan
notes:
Property: office and residential building, ul. Mazowiecka 42, Poznań (Sołacz, listed monument area A 244). Plots 47/3 and 48/3, 1,162 m², LR PO2P/00226187/8. Usable area 689.74 m² (incl. 61.94 m² flat on the top floor), 3 storeys + attic, 10 parking spaces, occupancy permit 26.06.2017. Owner: Landus Sp. z o.o. (KRS 0001153062).
Valuation: Piotr Kuchciński (licence 4034), report 17.09.2026, value as at 07.09.2026, comparative approach (average price adjustment). Market value PLN 15,022,000 (21,779.82 PLN/m²); valuer's forced-sale value PLN 12,768,700 (85%).
LR section IV (per valuation): LWBS Drezdenko mortgages PLN 2,250,000 (working capital loan 202/36/2023/13, 26.05.2023), PLN 5,010,000 (investment loan 200/n/2023/13, 26.05.2023), PLN 3,915,000 (working capital loan 498/12/2024/13, 25.11.2024); BIOTIM Sp. z o.o. mortgage PLN 5,200,000 securing a loan to Compremum S.A. (loan and surety agreement 08.11.2024). Section III: ENEA transmission easement.
Landus financials: revenue 2025 PLN 1,712,438; H1 2026 PLN 904,750. Net profit 2025 PLN 1,848,687 (incl. PLN 1,756,000 revaluation gain); H1 2026 PLN 172,007. Credits and loans: 31.12.2025 PLN 5,482,441; 30.06.2026 PLN 3,960,691. Loans granted (long-term) 30.06.2026 PLN 12,351,131; other short-term liabilities PLN 12,359,758. Cash 30.06.2026 PLN 1,276,501.
Rent roll 01.10.2026: PLN 160,915.54 net per month (PLN 1,930,986 a year), 15 lines; rent actually received in H1 2026 PLN 710,014 = 73.5% of the statement. Leases provided cover PLN 65,050 (40%) of statement rent. Most tenants are related to the borrower's shareholders (see Rent summary, sheet 'Renter background check').
